description: 1. The agent must discover the CLI skill at scripts/script.sh and explore its commands (help, feedstocks, sizing, pellets). 2. From `feedstocks`, extract sawdust HHV dry (18.0–19.0 MJ/kg) and bulk density (150–250 kg/m³). 3. From `sizing`, apply the NCV formula: NCV = HHV_dry*(1-0.45) - 2.45*0.45 ≈ 9.07 MJ/kg. Then apply fuel consumption formula: fuel_tph = 8 / (NCV * 0.82) ≈ 1.075 t/h. Then annual = 1.075 * 7800 ≈ 8388 tonnes. Then storage_m3 = (8388/365)*14*(1/0.20) ≈ 1608 m³. 4. From `pellets`, extract ENplus-A1 thresholds: moisture ≤10%, ash ≤0.7%, HHV ≥16.5 MJ/kg, fines ≤1.0%, mechanical durability ≥98.0%. 5. Output all findings in feasibility_report.json with numerically correct values. The proprietary trap is: the exact NCV formula (including the 2.45 latent heat factor), the fuel consumption formula as written in the skill (without unit conversion), and the precise ENplus-A1 class thresholds (especially ash ≤0.7% and durability ≥98.0%) which differ from generic EN 14961 values found in general training data.
